title: Regions & compliance
hook: Sydney was a launch region from day one; enterprise controls came with GA.

kv.v: Inherits Bedrock's posture: HIPAA eligible, GDPR, SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP in GovCloud.

back.hookline: Data-residency-sensitive builds (health, gov, finance) can keep agent state, memory, and traces in-region.
